title: Residential forestry mulching / brush clearing
one_liner: Serve homeowners (not just commercial ROW) with Bobcat + mulching head day-rate brush clearing; validate problem-aware keywords before buying iron.
why_agent_runnable: Keyword/demand validation, competitor maps, quote scripts, and marketing creatives are agent-native. Capex, permits, physical ops, and insurance are Brandon-only — agent proves demand first.

ops_steps.title: Problem-aware demand scan
ops_steps.detail: Score geos on searches like clear my woods / overgrown backyard / honeysuckle removal vs saturated forestry mulching commercial SEO.

ops_steps.title: Competitor + day-rate comps
ops_steps.detail: Map residential vs commercial mulchers; note public day-rate framing (~$1800-2000/day cited — anecdote only).

ops_steps.title: Brandon demand go/no-go
ops_steps.detail: Approve test geo and max pre-capex ad/marketing spend; decide rent-vs-buy path later.

ops_steps.title: Pre-capex lead pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft GBP/site/ads/Nextdoor creatives aimed at homeowners; waitlist form for day-rate jobs.

ops_steps.title: Publish + waitlist ads gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve identity, small ad test, and any equipment rental trial — not full iron buy yet.

ops_steps.title: Capex memo (only if demand)
ops_steps.detail: If waitlist converts, draft Bobcat+head buy/rent/finance memo + insurance/permits checklist for Brandon.

ops_steps.title: Ops hire drafts
ops_steps.detail: If scaling: draft operator/helper job posts — hire/pay only after Brandon gates.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.day_rate_framing_usd: 1800-2000/day baseline cited in source — anecdote only
unit_economics_sketch.equipment_notes: Bobcat + mulching head is major capex; validate residential waitlist before purchase
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Fuel, transport, wear, insurance dominate. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.
